build_note: The M13 port benchmark to Rust 2021 (Phase 19, chosen 2026-11-24): EasyRetry 2.2.0 (alicommit-malp/Easy-Retry, MIT), a netstandard2.0 and 2.1 library in C# latest with nullable annotations (6 files, 657 lines) that retries a Func<Task<T>>, a Func<Task> or an Action by a RetryOptions policy (backoff with jitter, a total duration, exception types not to retry, hooks), logging through an ILogger<EasyRetry>; 123 NUnit 4 tests on net8.0 (16 files). The first versions refused it twice: its async code (D-96) and its use of Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions 8.0.3 (D-95); its sync path sleeps on CancellationToken.WaitHandle.WaitOne, which D-96 covers. Nothing native, so the run's image is the port image itself. The repository's own CLAUDE.md is left in place, as a real project has it.
